name: A message box doesn't say what the test expects
covers: answerDialog's expect not matching the message: the failure is recorded with the message's actual words, the button is pressed anyway, and the case carries on

steps.say: Click Delete on Grace Hopper's order
The test expects the message to ask "Delete 1 order?", as an older version of Order Desk did. It asks something else now, so this fails, and the test still says No

steps.checkpoint: Grace Hopper's order is still there
look: The case failed at the message box, where the log has what the message really said. Everything after it still ran and passed.
